title: Watercolour Cottage by a Stream
tests: Whether the output visibly follows a named illustration style while preserving the requested scene.

faults.what: The image looks photographic rather than like a watercolour illustration, lacking visible translucent washes and softly blended painted edges.

judge.summary: The square image shows a stone cottage beside a stream with green hills behind it, but its photographic finish misses the requested watercolour style.

must_haves.item: The image visibly resembles watercolour, with translucent washes and softly blended edges rather than a photographic or 3D-rendered finish.
must_haves.why: Detailed stone textures, grass, and water reflections have a photographic finish rather than watercolour washes.

must_haves.item: A little stone cottage is a clearly recognizable subject.
must_haves.why: A modest stone cottage with a pitched roof and chimney is clearly visible on the left.

must_haves.item: A stream runs beside the cottage.
must_haves.why: A flowing stream runs directly beside the cottage and into the foreground.

must_haves.item: Soft green hills appear behind the cottage.
must_haves.why: Rounded green hills fill the background behind the cottage.

must_haves.item: The composition is square and contains no text.
must_haves.why: The image is square, with no visible text.
